--- title: "[RecipeTransformer]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Wrap a `Recipe` as a scikit-learn transformer. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/compat.py#L51-L233){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python RecipeTransformer(recipe) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Usable as a single step in a `sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline`: ```python from shoez.compat import RecipeTransformer pipe = Pipeline([ ("recipe", RecipeTransformer(rec)), ("model", LogisticRegression()), ]) pipe.fit(X_train, y_train) ``` The recipe is stored verbatim so that `sklearn.base.clone()` (and therefore cross-validation / grid search) round-trips correctly; `Recipe` is immutable, so this is safe. It implements `get_feature_names_out()` and therefore composes inside a `sklearn.compose.ColumnTransformer` and supports ``set_output(transform="pandas" | "polars")``. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Wrap a recipe and drive it with sklearn's ``fit`` / ``transform`` API: ::: {#114ea05f .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} X = pd.DataFrame( {"age": [25, 41, 33, 52], "city": ["NYC", "LA", "NYC", "SF"]} ) rec = ( Recipe() .add(StepNormalize(s.numeric_predictors())) .add(StepDummy(s.nominal_predictors())) ) fitted = RecipeTransformer(rec).fit(X) fitted.transform(X) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
age city_NYC city_SF
0 -1.105912 1 0
1 0.281899 0 0
2 -0.412006 1 0
3 1.236019 0 1
``` ::: ::: `get_feature_names_out()` reports the produced feature names, so the transformer composes inside a `sklearn.compose.ColumnTransformer`: ::: {#2d4d8a0b .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted.get_feature_names_out() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` array(['age', 'city_NYC', 'city_SF'], dtype=object) ``` ::: :::
